content: Prospero homeobox protein 1 (PROX1) is a protein encoded by the PROX1 gene in humans. The PROX1 protein has been demonstrated to interact with the EP300 protein. In terms of production, PROX1 is predominantly synthesized in the dentate gyrus of mice. In humans, it is primarily produced in the dentate gyrus and the white matter. Gene expression data for PROX1 in mice, humans, and macaques is available through the Allen Brain Atlases. Clinically, PROX1 serves as a reliable marker for identifying lymphatic endothelium in biopsy samples.
